name: Sena
source:
"I cannot say I am not interested in dating... But our duties are much too vital."

A standoffish member of the Blooms who acts snooty, but is kindhearted at her core.

Her unique ability is Foresight. It allows her to see one day into the future and provides accurate intel on the Vectors' movements, down to the second.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
